poll.source_locator: Post by CJ Warnke (HMP), Sep 28, 2026: 'NEW @HouseMajPAC poll in #OH15 Don Leonard: 46% Mike Carey: 45% Generic D: 48% Generic R: 47% ... 2024 recall: Trump+7'
poll.notes: Toplines from the HMP communications director's X post read via fxtwitter (x.com/cjwarnke/status/2104619061556457603). FIELD DATES (Sep 22-24) AND POLLSTER (Hart Research) ARE FROM WIKIPEDIA'S OH-15 polling table, which cites this same post; the post itself names neither. Wikipedia lists n=500 LV; not used. Post reports sample 2024 recall Trump+7 in a Trump+10 district; whether recall was a weighting target is not stated.
